platform: CJSR FM 88 Edmonton Digital Album/EP Submission Email and Physical Route
manual_review_reason: CJSR authorizes music@cjsr.com for digital albums and EPs but does not accept single tracks. The station requires actual downloadable files through stable cloud links or Bandcamp download codes, rejects Spotify, Tidal and other paid-streaming-only links, and advises against expiring services such as WeTransfer. A human must confirm that the selected release is an album or EP, verify ownership, track metadata, focus tracks, origin, track lengths, language warnings, download access and pitch copy, and confirm that the music is not wholly AI-generated under CJSR's January 2026 AI policy before sending manually.

platform: CJSF 90.1 FM National Music Director Submission Form and Music Coordinator Email
manual_review_reason: CJSF's official Music Department page directs releases to a National Music Director form that grants broadcast rights to CJSF and the participating campus-community network and distributes releases through !earshot Distro to more than 70 stations. Singles may enter !earshot Distro but are not considered for CJSF's local library; non-local physical submissions are rejected. The external form's live fields, privacy wording, discoverability/self-disclosure labels and any runtime login, CAPTCHA or validation controls were not passively enumerated. A human must review the rights grant, select accurate optional identity labels, confirm release type, local status, ownership, metadata and assets, inspect runtime controls and submit manually. The published cjsfmusc@sfu.ca Music Coordinator address remains a purpose-bound adjacent music contact and must not be used to bypass the current form.
